reasons.detail: R1 — Interactive setup now uses listSetupPresetCandidates(), which builds candidates from core presets and augments with plugin registry presets for the project.

R2 — Fresh interactive setup resolves official presets via officialPresetPluginRoot and includes them only through the pre-prompt candidate list; listSetupPresetCandidates throws a clear error when the official source is unresolved.

R3 — `setup.js` calls `ensureSetupOfficialPresetState` with selected preset types, which only mutates state for non-base official presets and writes official source/package entries plus installs `.senti/plugins/official-presets`; setup then reuses the prepared plugin section from config, so root-based preset resolution can find the preset.

R4 — `ensureSetupOfficialPresetState` exits early when only `base` is selected (`nonBaseTypes.length === 0`) and performs no writes, so a base-only setup does not add official preset source/package/plugin state.

R5 — `listSetupPresetCandidates` uses only loaded local plugin registry entries (plus optional official root) and never calls fetch/update routines for non-official packages. `loadPluginRegistry` skips packages whose `plugin.json` is missing, so missing installed non-official sources are ignored rather than fetched.

R6 — Diff routes setup defaults/wizard summary/leaf resolution/type minimization and preset validation through project-root-aware candidate lookup (listSetupPresetCandidates + resolve/validateCandidate helpers), and added parity tests cover defaults, non-interactive --type, minimization, and template lookup behavior.

R7 — Setup display path no longer uses core PRESETS directly; it now builds the preset tree from shared setup candidates, and the added test explicitly checks for removal of buildTreeItems(PRESETS) with candidate-based path usage.

R8 — `ensureSetupOfficialPresetState` updates plugin state through `readStoredProjectConfig`/`writeProjectConfig` on `.senti/config.json` only, `setup.js` snapshots/restores `config.json` and then only copies `preparedConfig.plugin` back into the final write, while local plugin state is never merged into this path; added test explicitly verifies private entries stay in `config.local` and are absent from published `config.json`.

R9 — Implemented. Candidate discovery now routes through `loadPluginRegistry` in strict mode and enforces plugin source/enabled-package limits, metadata size/path/symlink checks via `readPluginJson`/`pluginMetadataPath`, and preset-chain depth validation via `resolvePresetCandidateChains`/`validatePresetCandidateChains`; official preset reads also use the same manifest/preset metadata guards.

R10 — The new spec-local test files all start with `// spec:` headers, and together they reference R1, R2, R3, R4, R5, R6, R7, R8, R9, and R10; a dedicated test also asserts the expected headers are present at file start.
